summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay and Havoc Condition Manager; also supports Realms sessions. Build grouped generators from selected conditions, edit unit pools, weights and caps, and toggle extra spawns while preserving condition-required spawning.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 和浩劫词条管理器为前提，同时支持 Realms 联机会话。根据所选词条重建分类生成器，编辑单位池、权重、容量与刷新参数，并可开关额外投放，保留词条要求的生成行为。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 和浩劫詞條管理器為前提，同時支援 Realms 聯機會話。根據所選詞條重建分類生成器，編輯單位池、權重、容量與刷新引數，並可開關額外投放，保留詞條要求的生成行為。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay and Havoc Condition Manager; also supports Realms sessions. Build grouped generators from selected conditions, edit unit pools, weights and caps, and toggle extra spawns while preserving condition-required spawning.
